claims.text: Training and inference batches are constructed to leverage coreferent mentions by concatenating mentions with entity candidates, which indicates they come from the same document context.
The approach explicitly models mention coreference relationships across documents, suggesting that training and inference utilize mentions from the same document to improve performance.
The use of directed minimum spanning trees over mentions and entities indicates a systematic approach to leveraging coreferent mentions in both training and inference.
